beeperReadProtocolLegacy.mjs is the unchanged WhatsApp read protocol from actual
main 31deea2dec03a82473bd6db794850972dd5a1468, path
apps/mobile/src/services/beeper/readProtocol.mjs. It is a frozen mixed-version
regression fixture, not an activation implementation. Tests verify that updated
WhatsApp wire bytes stay compatible while iMessage headers fail its decoder.
